name: OmniRoute
description: OmniRoute is a free local AI gateway that routes requests across 200+ AI providers through a single OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint with intelligent fallback, compression, and a built-in web dashboard.

notes.text: Installs from pre-built npm package — no compilation needed (~1-2 min).
Configure provider API keys via the web dashboard on first login at http://<IP>:20128.
